from solution import and_tuples


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example: and of (10,4,6,9) and (5,2,3,3) is (0,0,2,1)."""
    # 10&5: 1010&0101=0000=0, 4&2: 0100&0010=0000=0, 6&3: 0110&0011=0010=2, 9&3: 1001&0011=0001=1
    assert and_tuples((10, 4, 6, 9), (5, 2, 3, 3)) == (0, 0, 2, 1)


def test_issue_all_zeros():
    """Elementwise and of zeros with zeros is zeros."""
    # 0&0=0, 0&0=0, 0&0=0
    assert and_tuples((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0)) == (0, 0, 0)


def test_issue_identical_values():
    """Elementwise and of identical values is the value itself."""
    # 7&7: 0111&0111=0111=7, 15&15: 1111&1111=1111=15
    assert and_tuples((7, 15), (7, 15)) == (7, 15)


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Elementwise and of single-element tuples is single-element tuple."""
    # 12&10: 1100&1010=1000=8
    assert and_tuples((12,), (10,)) == (8,)


def test_issue_empty_tuples():
    """Elementwise and of empty tuples is empty tuple."""
    assert and_tuples((), ()) == ()


def test_issue_disjoint_bits():
    """Elementwise and with no overlapping 1-bits is zero."""
    # 8&7: 1000&0111=0000=0, 4&1: 0100&0001=0000=0
    assert and_tuples((8, 4), (7, 1)) == (0, 0)


def test_issue_byte_mask():
    """Elementwise and masks bytes element by element."""
    # 255&15: 11111111&00001111=00001111=15, 128&255: 10000000&11111111=10000000=128
    assert and_tuples((255, 128), (15, 255)) == (15, 128)


def test_issue_partial_overlap():
    """Elementwise and keeps only overlapping 1-bits."""
    # 6&3: 0110&0011=0010=2, 12&10: 1100&1010=1000=8
    assert and_tuples((6, 12), (3, 10)) == (2, 8)


def test_issue_zero_against_nonzero():
    """Elementwise and of zero with anything is zero."""
    # 0&7=0, 5&0: 0101&0000=0000=0
    assert and_tuples((0, 5), (7, 0)) == (0, 0)


def test_contract_returns_tuple():
    """Result must be a tuple."""
    # 1&3: 0001&0011=0001=1, 2&4: 0010&0100=0000=0
    result = and_tuples((1, 2), (3, 4))
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)


def test_contract_preserves_length():
    """Result length equals input length."""
    result = and_tuples((1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 6))
    assert len(result) == 3


def test_contract_inputs_unchanged():
    """Inputs must not be modified."""
    t1 = (10, 4, 6, 9)
    t2 = (5, 2, 3, 3)
    and_tuples(t1, t2)
    assert (t1, t2) == ((10, 4, 6, 9), (5, 2, 3, 3))
